QuestInfo.name: Fanzy the Magical Cat
QuestInfo.0: #p1032001# seemed satisfied with your work for the fairies. Now, #p1032001# has something new for you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032001# told you to go visit #b#p1040002##k, the magical cat, to receive more advanced training. #b#p1040002##k is at the #b#m101030000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1040002# is a very...unique...cat. Furthermore, the cat claims that it is the first apprentice of #p1032001#...

0.msg: The fairies of #m101000000# have all been talking about your kindness. Even #p1032106#, who I don't think is interested in anyone besides #p1032106#...

1.msg: You are certainly improving in both skill and reputation. Perhaps it is time for you to do a little more training, hm? Don't make that face... Training is good for you, right?

2.msg: That is a wonderful mindset you have in your brain. You would do well to see my apprentice, #b#p1040002##k, at the #b#m101030000##k. His training will be difficult and occasionally very silly, so be ready. Oh, by the way, he is a cat. At least, that's what he was the last time I saw him. I wonder if he ever figured out how to fix that...\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to #m101030000# automatically.)#k#n

0.msg: Surely you are not content to stay at your current level! I mean, just look at it. That's it?

1.0: Me-ow! You look purrfectly suited to purrrvide meow with some entertainmeowent. Ha! I'm just kiddin'. I love doing the cat-talk thing. How the heck are mya? Dangit, now I can't stop meowself. Whatever. Old #p1032001# sent me a letter and said myou'd be comin' by. You ready for the hardest-core training myou could ever get anymeow?!

0.msg: #b#p1040002##k is my apprentice, and you can find him at the #b#m101030000##k. Go and see if he will train you. You might want to bring along some fish or a ball of string. He's terribly fond of those.
